principles: owner language over fleet implementation language
frozen_boundaries: GlyphForge production geometry and certification logic
mission: Make the owner bridge return deterministically to the real business home, speak owner language, and carry approved vessel identity without changing authority or production logic.
owner_bridge_rules: The bridge home is the only Overview; do not create a second Overview workspace.
Every sub-screen Overview action restores the full bridge home at the top.
Owner-facing copy uses business language; Fleet implementation vocabulary stays below the owner surface.
Approved vessel identity may personalize the bridge while layout, navigation, authority, and safety remain Fleet-standard.
Pricing remains the reference pattern for clear edit/save/durable-state behavior.
